---
name: Feature proposal
about: Suggest a new feature, chart type, or capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

## Problem this solves

What user need or pain point does this address? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you'd like and how you'd expect it to behave. Include:

- Where it lives in the UI (sidebar, panel, modal, etc.)
- What inputs it takes (dataset columns, config options, etc.)
- What output it produces (chart, table, file, side effect)

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is the proposed one better?

## Scope

- [ ] This feature can be added incrementally (small PR)
- [ ] This feature requires multiple PRs / a design discussion first
- [ ] Unsure; happy to discuss

## Additional context

Mockups, references to similar tools, links to research, etc.
